default_values_note: Every entry not listed in 'flagged_entries' below scored: semantic=PASS, d4_style_fidelity=PASS, special_illustration_quality=PASS, brand_trademark_leak=NO, text_leak=NO, screen_policy_leak=NO, border_ui_leak=NO, safety_concern=NO, anatomy_object_corruption=NO. recurring_face_observation.description: A specific 'long dark-haired, angular-jawed, serious male' face/presentation recurs across roughly 7 of the male-led/object-led cards (e.g. arts.newsletter_writing, arts.podcasting, books.reading, business.consulting, business.finance, business.remote_work) despite the deterministic diversity layer assigning genuinely different age/hair/build dimensions to each of these hobbies. This indicates the underlying model has a strong rendering prior toward one 'brooding male professional' archetype for certain contexts that the current diversity-layer phrasing does not fully override, even though the catalog-wide *assignment* distribution itself is confirmed even (see the Part-2 production-hardening handoff). This is a tuning opportunity for the face_hair_presentation/body_build phrasing, not a defect in the deterministic assignment mechanism itself.
counterexamples_showing_the_layer_does_w: grey/silver hair used naturally on both younger-styled and older character (arts.ceramics, arts.sticker_making, arts.puppetry, arts.square_dancing)
curly/coily hair and darker skin tones (arts.lion_dance, arts.pole_dance, arts.screen_printing, arts.mixed_media, arts.video_editing, business.marketing)
broader/sturdier build without caricature (arts.tap_dance, arts.sculpture's muscular older woman)
buzzed/very-short hair across multiple genders (arts.bird_photography, arts.macro_wildlife_photography, arts.painting_socials, arts.contemporary_dance, arts.landscape_photography)

arts (89 images).note: Leaks span several distinct sub-causes: calligraphy-family background scrolls, urban-night-scene signage, creator-tool screen UI chrome, and isolated cases (comedy_writing's whiteboard+book, hip_hop_dance's graffiti, zine_making's literal hobby-name text).

books (1 image).note: books.reading (the hobby fixed last round) rendered completely clean - confirms the fix holds in real production output.

business (30 images).note: SYSTEMIC CLUSTER DEFECT. More than half of all business.* cards render clearly readable diagram/whiteboard/kanban/flip-chart labels (e.g. 'SKILLS', 'GOAL', 'Empathy Map', 'REVENUE STREAMS', 'S&P 500', 'Backlog/Doing/Validation/Done', 'INITIATION/PLANNING/EXECUTION/MONITORING'). This is the dominant defect in the entire batch and is narrowly scoped to one runtime_category, with a clear likely cause: the business category's 'concept diagram / kanban board / planning board' recognition-anchor language leads the model to add literal English labels instead of abstract non-linguistic diagram marks, the same class of gap already fixed for lifestyle.game_nights (game pieces) and learning.philosophy (concept diagrams) at the individual-hobby level, but not yet addressed at the business-category level.

device_logo_family.description: Two clear, unambiguous real Apple logos rendered on laptop/tablet lids. This is a direct gap in global_brand_safety_policy's 'consumer electronics and devices' coverage - the policy text exists but was not reliably followed by the model for this specific device-logo case, twice in one 120-image batch.
device_logo_family.severity: high - most severe brand-safety finding of this round

footwear_silhouette_family.description: Recognizable real sneaker silhouette (no logo/text). Same class of residual risk already documented for sports.skateboarding after its hardening fix - confirms the global brand-safety policy reduces but does not eliminate this risk class for footwear-heavy scenes outside the hobbies with dedicated overrides.
